algorithm.hint_end: hint == header sentinel: node count nonzero and rightmost key < key returns (0, rightmost); otherwise the unhinted descent runs (inlined in the hinted routine)
algorithm.hint_larger: hint key < key: hint == rightmost returns (0, rightmost); successor key <= key falls back to the unhinted routine; key < successor key returns (0, hint) when the hint has no right child, else (successor, successor)
algorithm.hint_smaller: key < hint key: hint == leftmost returns (hint, hint); predecessor key >= key falls back to the unhinted routine; predecessor key < key returns (0, predecessor) when the predecessor has no right child, else (hint, hint)
algorithm.hinted_walk_duplication: the hinted routine's end-hint walk block repeats the unhinted descent instruction-for-instruction in shape; the only actual transfer to 0x5d49910 is the fallback tail jump at 0x5d4e3b0
algorithm.plt_helpers: in-order successor and predecessor are reached only through the Rb_tree_increment (0x63f0ea0) and Rb_tree_decrement (0x63f0df0) PLT stubs; their bodies are not pinned, only the call sites and the branch outcomes
algorithm.return_convention: (existing node, 0) means the key is already present; (0, parent) means the key is absent and inserts as a child of parent; (node, node) is a hint-path-only doubled pair, reproduced exactly
algorithm.unhinted_descent: start at the root; at each node go left when key < node key, else right; track the last node and the last step direction; stop at a null child
algorithm.unhinted_tail_went_left: leftmost last node returns (0, last); otherwise the predecessor decides: predecessor key >= key returns (predecessor, 0), predecessor key < key returns (0, last)
algorithm.unhinted_tail_went_right: last node is the candidate: key >= last key returns (last, 0); key < last key cannot occur on this path, and the shared tail instead returns (0, last) when the last key is above the key
